Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 139. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 12 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (15 foot cone)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
A wide short range blast from cupped hands.
All creatures in a 15 foot cone must make a dexterity
saving throw taking 4d12 Ki damage on a fail and half
on a success.
